svg.aria-label: Connect with Dhruvil Dhamecha: even the Devil needs friends. email, GitHub, LinkedIn, Instagram, HackerRank and Substack. Seeking internships and open to work.
svg.title: Connect: Even the Devil Needs Friends
svg.desc: Daredevil-themed connect card. A graded photo of three friends laughing outside Nelson Murdock Page, captioned I fight alone, still it never feels complete, beside six channels in monotone red logos: email, GitHub, LinkedIn, Instagram, HackerRank and Substack, over a night skyline with radar rings.

g.text: Good people, good code, good company. Pick any door.
Recruiters, teams and friends: say hi. Even vigilantes reply, usually after dark.
